pass_a_gloss: Confession before Father and angels; Firstborn-Image and David-seed Son-of-Man; furnace gold.
pass_b_english: Who, reckoning such things, would not confess before men, that Christ, God's Firstborn and Image, may confess him before his Father? And who would not confess before the angels Christ the Son of Man — of David's seed, of Abraham's seed, born of woman — that, being approved, he may be commended as confessor? For gold is proved in the furnace, and acceptable men in the furnace of humiliation. But who, fearing men, denies — denies the Son of Man before men, and shall be denied before the angels (Matthew 10:32–33) (Luke 12:8–9) (Wisdom 3:6).
